name: Mikva Summer Fellows
org: Mikva Challenge Illinois with the Illinois Department of Human Services Youth Investment Program
what_you_do: Fellows work for six weeks in the offices of city, county, state and federal leaders. They also go to weekly workshops on leadership, setting goals and job skills.
grades: Placed after senior year of high school
who_can_apply: About 50 young people after their senior year. Cook County youth, through the state youth program. Age limits not stated.
deadline_text: Recruitment for 2027 programs begins in spring 2027. Exact dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Recruitment for 2027 starts in the spring. Watch the Mikva Challenge program application page or email inquiries@mikvachallenge.org. Phone: (312) 863-6340.
notes: For young people after their senior year. The page does not state an age limit. The Illinois FAQ requires work permits only for workers under 16 and refers 16 and 17 year olds to federal rules.
